name: ComfyUI 3D Generator (Blender-ready)
description: Generates and edits 3D assets using a local ComfyUI API backend and optionally saves .blend files via Blender CLI.
author: Niivan16

inputs.name: text_prompt
inputs.label: Text Prompt
inputs.help: Describe what to generate or edit (used in the AI workflow).

inputs.name: existing_file
inputs.label: Existing 3D file (optional)
inputs.help: Provide an existing .obj/.gltf/.blend file to edit. If provided, the generator will attempt to edit this file instead of generating from scratch.

inputs.name: workflow_json
inputs.label: ComfyUI workflow (optional)
inputs.help: Optional: a ComfyUI workflow exported in 'API format' (JSON). If not provided, generator.py will use the internal placeholder workflow.
